name: Hash The Cove
description: Calculates additional whole-file fingerprints for Cove video and gallery files.
author: MidnightRider

settings.name: xxhash
settings.description: Calculate xxHash64 fingerprints. Disabled until explicitly enabled.

settings.name: sha256
settings.description: Calculate SHA-256 fingerprints. Disabled until explicitly enabled.

settings.name: sha1
settings.description: Calculate SHA-1 fingerprints. Disabled until explicitly enabled.

settings.name: hash_videos
settings.description: Process video files. Enabled when unset.

settings.name: hash_galleries
settings.description: Process gallery archive files. Enabled when unset.
